posts.text:
Steven Bartlett asks James Talarico how Texas chases “equality” without chasing off figures like @ElonMusk.

Talarico’s answer: Musk’s net worth is a “spiritual sickness,” and the rich should pay something closer to the 1950s rate of 90%.

BARTLETT: “What would you have done to stop [Elon from becoming a trillionaire]?”

TALARICO: “We at one point in this country, we had, I think it was in the 1950s, had a top marginal tax rate of 90%. I don’t think it needs to be that high, but we used to have a political system and an economic system that more fairly distributed the fruits of our labor.”

“And I think the thing that really upsets people, particularly about the Elon example, is that Tesla was successful because of taxpayer dollars, right? Tesla got investment from the federal government, which is why it has been so successful.”

CONTEXT: The taxpayer dollars Tesla received were a LOAN from the Department of Energy in 2010. Ford got $5,900,000,000, and Nissan got $1,400,000,000 from the same program.

But Tesla did something those automakers hadn’t. It repaid the full $465,000,000 it had borrowed, with interest, 9 years ahead of schedule, becoming the first automaker in the program to pay its loan back in full.

posts.text:
Grok Bot is literally a game changer for me

I can't say this enough, but Grok Bot has given me soo much peace of mind. It basically does everything for me that I don't want to do

All those little tasks that used to take up so much of my time and energy are now being handled by Grok Bot

I don't even book my flights or hotels anymore. Grok Bot does it for me

I literally boarded a plane right now, and the entire booking was handled by Grok Bot haha

And the crazy part is that I actually feel much safer letting it handle everything

It goes through all the options, compares them, intelligently shortlists the best ones and shows me screenshots and relevant links so I can check everything myself

And before spending any money, it asks me to approve the final payment

I really feel like it does a better job than I would have done myself

And it goes so much further than just booking things

It already knows my current location, where I'm staying, my travel plans, how to get to the airport and what time I should leave

Everything is taken care of

And whenever I need help with something, instead of spending time searching Google or figuring things out myself, I just talk to Grok Bot

Because it already planned and booked everything for me, it has all the context it needs and gives me answers that are actually useful for my situation

It even takes care of little things I wouldn't have thought about myself

I really never imagined an SI agent would make my everyday life this much easier

It's not just about saving time anymore

It's about having so many things taken off my mind that I don't have to constantly worry about them

And that feeling is absolutely incredible

Grok Bot has completely changed how I get things done

wtf is Grok Jarvis.

Grok Jarvis is a Grok Bot plus a Page.

The bot holds the personality. The Page is the live screen it builds from plain English.

No code. Two prompts and one fix message.

8 parts that make Grok Jarvis work:

1. The personality
• Calm, short, precise, a little dry humour
• Calls you by your name
• Says what it'll do in one line, does it, reports back in one line

2. The morning brief
• Say "Good morning, Jarvis"
• Hear what every bot did and what's waiting on you
• Get the one thing to do first

3. The Systems panel
• Lists every bot you run with a status light
• Shows the last thing each one did
• Mine reads 31 active bots

4. Waiting on you
• Lines up every decision that needs your yes
• Approve or Later on each one
• Ticks off on your screen only, nothing gets sent

5. The voice
• Reads every answer out loud
• The glowing core pulses while it speaks
• The reply types out under the core

6. Quick commands
• Morning brief, Status, What's waiting, Focus mode
• Or type a sentence in the command bar
• Focus mode dims the panels and calms the motion

7. The self-fix
• My first screen broke: the core was missing
• I told Jarvis what I saw and pasted the error
• It fixed its own work and sent a bigger core

8. Its own computer
• Opens a browser and searches Google for you
• Reads competitor sites one by one and returns a table
• Says your rules back first: only read, no forms, no contact

follow @JulianGoldieSEO for more on Grok Bot.
